title: Regional Disposal Fee Uplift on the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Haul-Away Limit
content:
**Network schedule extract.** A disposal uplift is added to the haul-away limit for equipment replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, for the disposal fee schedule Bridgewell's network applies in the region where the base homeowner property lies. The region is read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract.

| Property ZIP code | Region | Disposal uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 90000 through 96199 | California | USD 35.00 |
| 73000 through 79999 | Oklahoma and Texas | USD 10.00 |
| Any other ZIP code | | None |

**Range edges.** ZIP codes 90000 and 96199 fall in the first range, 96200 does not; ZIP codes 73000 and 79999 fall in the second range, 72999 and 80000 do not.
